title: lithospermum parviflorum
intro: Lithospermum parviflorum, commonly known as small-flowered gromwell, is a perennial plant species belonging to the borage family (Boraginaceae). It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin issues. The health benefits of Lithospermum parviflorum are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, helping to soothe and protect the body. The bioactive constituents responsible for these actions are shikonin, a naphthoquinone pigment, and other glycosides, which contribute to the plant's medicinal value.
